_comment: Single source of truth for offers + core services. Prices are BASE (EU/EUR). US/USD is derived at render time via region.priceFactor (tiers) and region.valueFactor (value stack), rounded to x,x97 / nearest 100. anchor/roi copy is stored per region. Consumed by src/js/data.js (runtime) and generate_offers.py (build).
guarantee: 30-Day Implementation Guarantee — if your Done-For-You system isn't live within 30 days, we cover your first month.
